
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/22264114" title="发布于 2026-08-06 07:05">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">3. 1个Tool！让Agent自动生成测试用例</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>上一节让 Agent 自己把需求文档读进来了。文档进了上下文，下一步就该根据需求整理测试用例，并落到文件里。create_deep_agent 的 tools 参数，就是用来扩展这类业务能力的——想让它整理用例并保存成 YAML，提供对应的 Tool 即可。</p>
<p>配套的动画视频在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1zCKY6CESd/" rel="noopener nofollow">《3. 1个Tool！让Agent自动生成测试用例》</a>。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="322.26" data-width="1992" data-height="672" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/0deb72dae4e30cf9d454d24939a1253a3546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260806070533422-102665330.png"></p>
<p>自定义 Tool 可以按四块来搭。入参模型继承 BaseModel，用来声明并校验工具入参；工具类继承 BaseTool，声明 name、description 和 args_schema。description 要写清楚这个工具做什么、需要什么参数、结果统一存到哪里，Agent 会据此决定是否调用。执行逻辑放在 _run 里，在方法内完成 YAML 文档存储等导出操作。test_tools.py完整代码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> typing <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Type
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> pathlib <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> pydantic <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BaseModel, Field
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.tools <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BaseTool
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os, yaml

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GenerateTestCasesInput(BaseModel):
    test_cases: list </span>= Field(description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用例列表：case_id/case_name/description/steps</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    output_path: str </span>= Field(description=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">YAML输出路径</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GenerateTestCasesTool(BaseTool):
    name: str </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">generate_test_cases</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    description: str </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">将测试用例列表保存为YAML。用例含case_id、case_name、description、steps；step含action与params</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    args_schema: Type[BaseModel] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GenerateTestCasesInput

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> _run(self, test_cases: list, output_path: str) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            base_dir </span>= os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__file__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> output_path.startswith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
                output_path </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.normpath(
                    os.path.join(base_dir, output_path.lstrip(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
                )
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">elif</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.isabs(output_path):
                output_path </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os.path.normpath(
                    os.path.join(base_dir, output_path)
                )
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i, case <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enumerate(test_cases):
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">case_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> case <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">steps</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> case:
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">错误：第{i + 1}个用例缺少case_id或steps</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            output_file </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path(output_path)
            output_file.parent.mkdir(parents</span>=True, exist_ok=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True)
            with open(output_file, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">w</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
                yaml.dump(
                    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">test_cases</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: test_cases},
                    f,
                    allow_unicode</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True,
                    default_flow_style</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">False,
                )
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">成功保存{len(test_cases)}个用例至：{output_path}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">保存失败：{str(e)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> get_all_tools() -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> [GenerateTestCasesTool()]</pre>
</div>
<p>工具写好后，在 create_deep_agent 里加上 tools=get_all_tools() 就行。接着给 Agent 一条提示词，让它调用 generate_test_cases 生成测试用例并保存——把要求写清楚即可：读哪些文档、用哪个工具、保存到哪。run_automation_test.py完整代码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> deepagents <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_deep_agent
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> deepagents.backends <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LocalShellBackend
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> test_tools <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get_all_tools

load_dotenv()
os.environ[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OPENAI_API_KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] = os.getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">API_KEY</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
os.environ[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OPENAI_BASE_URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] = os.getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">BASE_URL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
model </span>= f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openai:{os.getenv('MODEL')}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_test_agent():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_deep_agent(
        model</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model,
        system_prompt</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HarmonyOS 自动化测试专家。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        tools</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">get_all_tools(),
        backend</span>=LocalShellBackend(root_dir=os.getcwd(), virtual_mode=True, inherit_env=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True),
        debug</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True,
    )

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main():
    agent </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_test_agent()
    result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.invoke(
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
                {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: (
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">读取 docs/ 下的需求文档，用 generate_test_cases 工具生成测试用例，保存到 testcases/test_data.yaml。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                    ),
                }
            ]
        }
    )
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][-1].content[0][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__name__</span> == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__main__</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    main()</span></pre>
</div>
<p>跑完后，testcases/test_data.yaml 里就会留下 Agent 整理好的用例。到这一步，从读需求到生成测试用例的链路就打通了。</p>
<p>配套的动画视频在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1zCKY6CESd/" rel="noopener nofollow">《3. 1个Tool！让Agent自动生成测试用例》</a>。</p>
